# Voltura Air

Voltura Air is free, open-source Windows software from Voltura AB. It turns a
phone, tablet, or browser-capable device into a local-network control surface
for a Windows 11 PC.

## Core capabilities

- Touch trackpad, Enhanced-capabilities gyro mouse on sensor-equipped phones
  and tablets, keyboard, browser-supported dictation, media remote, and
  landscape split mode.
- Presentation mode for PowerPoint, Google Slides, and
  PDF/browser control, with trackpad, native laser pointer, timer, statistics,
  and optional reports stored on the PC.
- YouTube, Kodi, browser, media, volume, window, and approved application
  controls.
- Custom screens designed on the PC with responsive buttons,
  collapsible panels, safe shortcuts/actions, optional regular or collapsible
  trackpads, read-only Windows preview, and per-device assignment.
- Acknowledged text transfer to reviewed PC destinations and an explicit,
  host-permitted PC clipboard text read.
- A touch-first Files on PC tool for browsing and managing files that remain on
  the Windows host or mapped drives, with one/two-panel layouts, background
  operations, Windows clipboard integration, and separate host permissions.
- An optional Phone webcam tool with default-off audio that exposes a selected
  paired-phone camera over Enhanced Direct or Relay. Active audio can be muted from
  the phone and tested through the Windows page. Audio requires user-installed
  VB-CABLE from VB-Audio; it is third-party donationware, Voltura Air does not include
  or distribute it, and the user is responsible for the applicable licence.
- Keep Windows awake while Voltura Air runs, with an optional Keep screen on
  setting.
- Host-controlled permissions for paired devices and disruptive PC actions.
- QR pairing with saved reconnect over Direct LAN or optional end-to-end
  encrypted Cloud relay.
- Cloud relay makes the Windows PC and mobile device connect outward, avoids an
  incoming PC firewall exception, and supports encrypted commands plus live
  screen viewing with Standard and Data saver quality choices.
- Initial Direct connections use a 3-second startup window; Relay connections
  allow 10 seconds to tolerate additional VPN or managed-network latency.
- Reviewed custom screens can be browsed at https://voltura.se/air/screens/ and
  imported into Voltura Air after local review.

## Product boundaries

- No account is required for the app. Direct LAN is the default; optional Cloud
  relay carries encrypted commands and TURN-relayed encrypted screen media.
  The separate community library uses an
  optional account for submissions, ratings, and submission management.
- Not a general remote-desktop, file-sync, device file-transfer, or
  public-internet remote-control service.
- A sleeping or shut-down PC cannot receive a Voltura Air wake command.
- Release binaries are not code-signed, so Windows may show an
  unknown-publisher or SmartScreen warning.

## Distribution

Releases provide a default installer that can download missing .NET 10 Desktop
and ASP.NET Core runtimes, a full installer that includes the runtimes, and a
portable ZIP.
